meta.description: Firmographic enrichment via Datagma (RapidAPI). Single domain call returns founded, hq_address, funding_stage, total_funding, ceo_name, company_size, revenue. Safe-upsert via /admin/enrich-write — skips already-populated fields. Replaces dead Tracxn enricher (M75).

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ vendor_website: $json.website, column: 'crawl_datagma_result', payload: { ok: true, pipeline: 'csp-firmographic-enrichment', crawled_at: new Date().toISOString(), fields: $json.extracted } }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, website: $('Map Fields').first().json.website, fields_written: Object.keys($('Map Fields').first().json.extracted) }) }}
